title: WHERE and HAVING Together
flavorText: Use WHERE to exclude individual rows, then HAVING to exclude whole groups. Both in the same query — powerful.
narrative: Filter transactions to Electronics products only (WHERE), then show only months where total Electronics revenue exceeds 500 (HAVING).
schemaSql: CREATE TABLE sales (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, month TEXT NOT NULL, product TEXT NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, amount REAL NOT NULL, category TEXT NOT NULL);
seedSql: INSERT INTO sales VALUES (1,'Jan','Datapad',3,899.97,'Electronics'),(2,'Jan','Power Cell',10,199.90,'Electronics'),(3,'Feb','Datapad',5,1499.95,'Electronics'),(4,'Feb','Logic Board',2,179.98,'Electronics'),(5,'Mar','Optic Lens',1,149.99,'Optics'),(6,'Mar','Servo Motor',4,220.00,'Robotics'),(7,'Mar','Datapad',2,599.98,'Electronics'),(8,'Apr','Power Cell',20,399.80,'Electronics'),(9,'Apr','Logic Board',5,449.95,'Electronics'),(10,'Apr','Steel Cable',50,425.00,'Hardware');
task: Show months where total Electronics sales (amount) exceeded 500. Order by month alphabetically.

hints.text: WHERE category = 'Electronics' filters rows first. Then GROUP BY month with HAVING SUM(amount) > 500 filters groups.
SELECT month, SUM(amount) AS elec_sales FROM sales WHERE category = 'Electronics' GROUP BY month HAVING SUM(amount) > 500 ORDER BY month;
SELECT month, SUM(amount) AS elec_sales FROM sales WHERE category = 'Electronics' GROUP BY month HAVING SUM(amount) > 500 ORDER BY month;
